title: Verify the remapped Linux debug candidate in the GUI
changes: Record selected graphical and local-channel execution of the path-remapped portable candidate from a moved bundle.
validation: A protected candidate archive was extracted into a spaced Unicode folder. Three isolated interpreter sessions using its exact runtime and the same public synthetic seed performed a read-only 16-byte inspection and one neutral frame through menu, local-control CLI and interactive command console. Inspection results, origin and endpoint state/frame/clock/registers/keys matched; GUI sessions closed normally and protected inputs were unchanged. Console output screenshot reviewed (dbg28-candidate-gui-g5denal6).
limitations: This synthetic Xvfb check covers only inspection and one frame with simulated keyboard/mouse; physical controller, native Windows, old-version/empty-state behavior, full integration and release remain open.
